note: The denial letter is always authoritative. Never guess an address.

routes.phone: The number on your ID card
routes.mail: The appeal address printed on your denial letter
routes.how: Sign in at member.uhc.com and file the appeal there, or call the number on your card. There is no single public appeals fax or PO box — use the address on your denial letter.

routes.phone: 1-800-872-3862, or the number on your card
routes.how: Fill out Aetna's Member Complaint and Appeal Form (in your account at aetna.com, under complaints, grievances and appeals) and fax or mail it. Confirm the address on your denial letter first.

routes.phone: 1-800-244-6224, or the number on your card
routes.mail: The appeal address printed on your denial letter
routes.how: Log in at my.cigna.com to find your plan's appeal form and submit it there, or call the number on your card. The mailing address is plan-specific — use the one on your denial letter.

routes.portal: anthem.com, or the Sydney Health app
routes.phone: The number on the back of your ID card
routes.mail: The plan- and state-specific address on your denial letter
routes.how: Anthem (Elevance) plans are state- and plan-specific. Log in at anthem.com or call the number on your card, and send your written appeal to the address on your denial letter.

routes.phone: Expedited: 1-800-867-6601, or the number on your card
routes.mail: Humana Grievances and Appeals, P.O. Box 14546, Lexington, KY 40512-4546
routes.how: Get the appeal form at resolutions.humana.com, then mail it to the Grievances and Appeals PO box (expedited requests use P.O. Box 14165). Confirm on your denial letter.
routes.window: Confirm the window on your denial letter

routes.portal: ambetterhealth.com (pick your state, then the appeal/grievance form)
routes.phone: The number on your ID card
routes.mail: The state plan address printed on your denial letter
routes.how: Ambetter/Centene is run per state. Go to ambetterhealth.com, choose your state, and use that state's appeal form, or call the number on your card. Mail to the address on your denial letter.

routes.phone: The Member Services number on your ID card
routes.mail: State-specific — the address printed on your denial letter
routes.how: Molina is run per state. Sign in at molinahealthcare.com or call the number on your card, and mail your appeal to the address on your denial letter.
routes.window: Confirm the window on your denial letter

routes.portal: Blue Access for Members (bcbsil.com, bcbstx.com, bcbsnm.com, bcbsok.com, bcbsmt.com)
routes.phone: The number on your ID card
routes.mail: The plan-specific address printed on your denial letter
routes.how: Log in to Blue Access for Members on your state's Blue site, or call the number on your card, and mail your appeal to the address on your denial letter.

routes.mail: HMO plans: Florida Blue HMO, Attn: HMO Appeals, P.O. Box 41609, Jacksonville, FL 32203-1609 (other Florida Blue plans use a different address — check your denial letter)
routes.how: Get the appeal form under Member Forms at floridablue.com or call the number above. The mailing address depends on your plan type, so confirm it on your denial letter.
routes.window: Confirm the window on your denial letter

routes.mail: Original Medicare: the Medicare Administrative Contractor address on your Medicare Summary Notice (MSN)
routes.how: Original Medicare: file a redetermination (form CMS-20027) with the contractor listed on your MSN. Medicare Advantage or Part D: appeal to your plan using the address on your denial notice.
routes.window: Original Medicare: 120 days from the MSN. Medicare Advantage: 60 days

routes.mail: Your state Medicaid agency or managed-care plan — the address on your denial letter
routes.how: Medicaid is run by your state. Appeal through your state Medicaid agency or your managed-care plan, and you can also ask for a state fair hearing. All of the details are on your denial letter.
routes.window: Often just 30 to 90 days — act quickly and check your letter
